WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count,
    (COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account)) as share
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    account_count,
    share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn
  FROM district_counts
),
min_tenth_share AS (
  SELECT MIN(share) as threshold
  FROM ranked_districts
  WHERE rn <= 10
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  account_count,
  share
FROM district_counts
WHERE share >= (SELECT threshold FROM min_tenth_share)
ORDER BY share DESC
